decidedBy: 원장님 2026-11-23: 겹침 같은 걸 다 실패로 처리하지 말고, 학생이 봤을 때 최소한 읽히면 통과. 100점짜리가 아니라 90점짜리 SVG.
about: Publication gate only. The observers keep finding and recording everything; this table decides what a finding costs. Fields may be added, never removed or loosened silently (bump version).
accumulation: every finding costs points and repeats of the same code add up with no cap

tracks.DEDUCT: quality judgement (overlap, nearness, distance, density): points off by degree
tracks.WAIT_ENGINE: no place found, so no figure: the engine must place at a fallback spot (R1-2); not scored here
tracks.INDETERMINATE: cannot judge / environment: never covered by a score
tracks.BLOCK: 0 points regardless of the rest: wrong value, answer shown in a problem figure, required value missing, broken or empty figure, label pointing at the wrong object, clipped by the viewBox, or a severe degree

stages.post-render: observer ran on the rendered SVG, so a candidate SVG exists inside the compose step
stages.placement: the generator stopped before any SVG existed

overlap.unit: overlapped area / area of the smaller label box (0..1)
overlap.note: half of a label hidden by another label or shape is a block

distance.unit: shortfall (too close) or excess (too far) in label-box heights

outside.unit: px the label box lies inside the safe margin shortfall / margin (d), plus fraction of the box outside the viewBox (clippedFraction)
outside.note: more than 10% of the label box outside the viewBox is a clipped value = block

oversize.note: only for codes waiting on the engine (WAIT_ENGINE); reference value

fontShortfall.note: below about 8 CSS px is unreadable

blockAlways: answer shown in a problem figure
label points at the wrong object (owner error)
clipped by the viewBox (more than 10% of a label box, or any figure part)
label more than half covered by another label or shape
